reason: Hypothesis B directly addresses the precipitation issue with a specific Hf addition, is grounded in the same alloy system (W-Ta-Cr-V) with direct evidence of Hf suppressing Cr-V precipitation under similar irradiation conditions, and proposes a clear, testable falsification experiment. Hypothesis A extrapolates from different alloy systems and introduces Zr, which lacks direct evidence for suppressing Cr-V precipitation in this base alloy and adds an unverified sintering benefit.
